name: Quad Cities Waterways
description: The 309 rivers, lakes and reservoirs of USGS's National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) that meet SCOUT's Quad Cities flood grid (-90.6879, 41.4150 to -90.4252, 41.6242), clipped to it, 29 km2 of water: NHD's large-scale Area layer, its stream and river areas (FTYPE 460, the Mississippi's channel), and its large-scale Waterbody layer, its lakes and ponds (390) and reservoirs (436); swamps and marshes (466) are left out. NHD's columns GNIS_NAME, FTYPE, FCODE and AREASQKM (the whole feature's area, before clipping). From hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/nhd/MapServer, layers 9 and 12. USGS, public domain.
